description: Press a key on the keyboard. Use this for keyboard shortcuts, Tab navigation, Enter, Escape, arrow keys, etc. Supports key combinations like "Ctrl+A" or "Shift+Tab".

key.description: Key to press. Examples: "Tab", "Enter", "Escape", "ArrowDown", "Backspace", "Shift+Tab", "Ctrl+A". For single characters, use the character directly (e.g., "a").

ref.description: Optional element reference from snapshot to focus before pressing the key.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to focus before pressing the key.

tab.description: The tab to drive: a handle of this session such as "t2" (list_tabs, new_tab). Default: the session's current tab.

name: press_key
